xerath.why: Between Q/W/E/R's mana costs, whether Mana Surge's champion-doubled restoration keeps a full-mana Xerath casting on cooldown for 15s is a real resource-budget question. Rite of the Arcane is a channel with several independently-timed Arcane Barrage recasts whose damage ramps up per successful hit (Arcane Perfection); Arcanopulse is an ordinary charge-then-release. Eye of Destruction's epicenter bonus just assumes the cast is always centered on the dummy.
